Quit Puffing — Creator & Lead Developer (Own Product) • Habit Recovery

Comprehensive, interactive Flutter application designed to assist smokers in breaking nicotine dependency through positive reinforcement, gamification, and evidence-based biological recovery timelines.

The Challenge & Problem

Individuals attempting to quit smoking suffer from high relapse rates during acute cravings due to lack of immediate dopamine-replacing interventions and absent recovery feedback.

Engineered Solution & Architecture

Architected a responsive Flutter Material 3 application featuring real-time smoke-free duration tracking, savings calculations, 5-minute guided SOS craving battles, and a local-first virtual XP economy.

Technical Challenges Solved

Ensuring 100% offline-first reliability and sub-second calculation of progressive health milestone percentages across background cycles without draining battery.

My Role & Contribution

Conceived, designed, and programmed the application from scratch. Built custom animation loops, local storage schema, and executed Google Play Store deployment.

Technologies & Frameworks Used

  • Flutter
  • Dart
  • Material 3
  • Local Storage
  • Gamification
  • State Management
  • Android
